title: Lisbon opens its first night-time tram line

entities.name: Carris
entities.context: Lisbon's transport company, which runs the trams.

entities.name: Lisbon
entities.context: City where the night tram line opened.

entities.name: Remodelado
entities.context: Historic tram cars built in the 1930s.

claims.claim: Carris launched a night-time service on tram line 28.
Carris expects around 3,000 riders a night in the first summer.

relationships.description: Carris rebuilt the Remodelado cars in the 1990s.

contradictions.claim: The night service will worsen noise in Alfama.
contradictions.against: The city council says the line runs quieter than the buses it replaces.

summary: Lisbon's Carris launched a night tram service on line 28.
